name: sia-backend
description: Backend Sistem Informasi Akademik (Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T db psql -U sia -d sia_db -f - < db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U sia -d sia_db -f - < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
